As Transport Planning Team Leader, you are responsible for the daily management of the planning team. You ensure that operational planning runs efficiently and actively contribute to the further development of the department.

Wat ga je doen?- Managing, coaching and supporting transport planners.
- Monitoring the quality, efficiency and progress of the daily planning.
- Optimising processes and working methods within the department.
- Maintaining contact with customers, drivers and internal departments.
- Analysing performance and identifying improvement opportunities.
- Supporting capacity and resource planning.
- Ensuring optimal deployment of drivers and equipment.
- Acting as the main point of contact for operational challenges and escalations.

Wat vragen we?- You have several years of experience as a transport planner within the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany.
- You have proven experience in a managerial or coordinating role, or you are ready for the next step in your career.
- Experience within the floriculture sector is a plus.
- You have a good command of the Dutch and English language, both spoken and written; German is a plus.
- You are strong in planning, organising and setting priorities.
- You have excellent communication skills.
- You are analytical, result-oriented, stress-resistant and decisive.
- You are a team player who knows how to motivate and develop employees.
- Working in shift patterns and weekend shifts according to schedule is not a problem for you.

Wat bieden we?- Dynamic position within a growing international family-owned company.
- Salary depending on experience.
- 8% holiday allowance.
- Additional pension scheme.
- Free parking.
- Travel allowance (for distances over 10 km).
- Company phone.
- Daily breakfast.
- Fun company activities and team outings.
- Room for initiative and personal development.
